parts.label: Solid
parts.note: Particles packed in rows: they only vibrate

parts.label: Liquid
parts.note: Particles touch but slide past each other

parts.label: Gas
parts.note: Particles far apart, moving fast in all directions

parts.label: Melting
parts.note: Heat makes the particles shake free of their rows

parts.label: Boiling
parts.note: More heat lets particles escape and fly apart
